text:
Maria (CSM): Quick heads up — our Week 2->3 trial conversion for the ‘Starter’ cohort decelerated ~30% this week. Thinking we need a lightweight 'save grid' for low-touch trials to intercept before they downgrade or churn. Suggestions?

Liam (SE): Oof. Any pattern on which feature flag or onboarding step they're dropping off at?

Maria (CSM): Early signs point to embedding setup + first-query fail rate. Also lower email open rates. No single failure, more of a friction cascade.

Emma (Product): Can we do a two-tier flow: automated in-app checklist + an unblock email, then if still stalled -> 15-min waived 1:1?

Maria (CSM): Exactly what I'm imagining. Sketch:
- Day 3: in-app checklist + nudge (CTA: "Run starter demo")
- Day 7: automated email with quick troubleshooting KB + 1-click schedule link (15-min waiver)
- Day 10: in-app modal promoting 1:1 if the checklist isn't complete
- Day 14: trial-extension + discount waiver if still inactive (only for accounts > X events)

Liam (SE): For KB links, can we include a tiny diagnostic snippet they can paste? e.g., `curl https://api.redwood.ai/health -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"` to check connectivity. That'll reduce support ops.

Ryan (Support): Love the diagnostic idea. We can add a support tag so when a user schedules the waived 15-min, the ticket auto-creates with `priority: trial_save`. Opsbot can post the ticket id back to the thread.

Opsbot: created ticket #TRIAL-4572 for waived 15-min schedule (assigned -> Ryan).

Emma (Product): Guardrails: only offer the waived 15-min for accounts with >5 API calls or >1 team seat to avoid being too generous. Also cap discount waiver to 20% or extend trial by 7 days.

Maria (CSM): Agreed on thresholds. Also want a short survey after the 1:1: 2 quick q's — main blocker + willingness to continue at current plan (yes/no/maybe). Capture as properties on the account.

Liam (SE): Implementation notes: Feature flags for the flow, a flux for who sees the modal, and a webhook that fires to Support. I can prototype the modal copy and KB snippet today.

Ryan (Support): I'll add the `trial_save` ticket template and auto-assignment rules. Also propose a canned reply library for the 15-min call to keep consistency.

Maria (CSM): Cool. Next steps:
1) Liam -> modal + diagnostics prototype (ETA: 48h)
2) Ryan -> ticket template + canned replies (ETA: 48h)
3) Emma -> product guardrail config + discount caps in rollout config (ETA: 72h)
4) Maria -> build short post-call survey + trigger to account properties (ETA: 48h)

Emma (Product): I'll also add analytics events for each step so we can A/B the hook copy and measure lift.

Maria (CSM): Assigning follow-ups: Liam -> @Liam (SE), Ryan -> @Ryan (Support), Emma -> @Emma (Product). I'll own the play doc and the final runbook.

Liam (SE): 👍 I'll drop a prototype link in #eng-help once done.

Ryan (Support): 👍 adding ticket template now.

Opsbot: Reminder set: follow-up sync in 72h (thread reminder).

Maria (CSM): Thanks team — want to keep this lightweight but actionable. If we get a +5% conversion lift from this grid it pays for itself.
